episodes.synopsis: A young boy named Daichi is trying to photograph ghosts when he happens upon a mysterious house.
episodes.title: Secret House

episodes.synopsis: Because their house travels through time, Mai always has to leave friends behind. This has caused her to normally keep her distance from others, but then she meets Konami in high school.
episodes.title: Friends

episodes.synopsis: Mii decides she wants to cosplay as a magical girl and go around helping people, which leads to her meeting a sickly girl named Miyuki.
episodes.title: Magic

episodes.synopsis: Alone in the mansion's Christmas shop, Mea meets a mysterious girl who insists that Mea fixes her doll. Shortly thereafter, however, the girl vanishes, and soon so do the three sisters.
episodes.title: All Alone

episodes.synopsis: Appearing at the construction site of an amusement park, Ai encounters a dandelion that knows where to find Shizuku, the girl they've been searching for.
episodes.title: Hot Springs

episodes.synopsis: The mansion returns to the amusement park five years later where Mai has a reunion with her sisters.
episodes.title: I'm Home

episodes.synopsis: It's been thirty years since Daichi encountered the three sisters, and after seeing their mansion in a photograph of his daughter he goes searching for them.
episodes.title: Things I Can't Say

episodes.synopsis: Appearing at a Shinto shrine, Mii meets Nono, a devout priestess in training. Nono loves Christmas but her grandfather dislikes all non-Shinto ways and beliefs.
episodes.title: Christmas

episodes.synopsis: Returning to the city where Mai met Konami forty years earlier, Mai mistakes her daughter, also called Mai, for Konami and tries to befriend her.
episodes.title: Once more

episodes.synopsis: Mai is distraught after what happened with Konami and tries to destroy the portrait they drew together but Mea intervenes.
episodes.title: Gift

episodes.synopsis: Keith leads the three sisters to Shizuku, finally ending their long search. Weary from the constant traveling and losing friends made along they way, they ask her to let them each return to Daichi, Konami, and Nono respectively.
episodes.title: Farewell

episodes.synopsis: Mai, the now grown-up daughter of Konami, is telling a curious Daisuke, the youngest child of Daichi, about the three time traveling sisters.
episodes.title: Popotan
